title: Norito Streaming
summary: The process of chunking Norito payloads for SoraFS/SoraNet transport with deterministic framing. Norito/Kaigi streams chunk payloads with deterministic framing, enabling relays to spool data to disk and refresh manifests on governance updates while maintaining consistency across the network.
